title: Land of the Lustrous
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On a far-future Earth, sentient gem beings guarded by their teacher Kongo fight the Lunarians, who raid from the moon to shatter and carry them off. The fragile, restless Phosphophyllite seeks a purpose and is transformed piece by piece over a long, philosophical story that draws on Buddhist imagery (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up searching honestly for one's purpose and the cost of change, while questioning what release from suffering truly means.
